name: vuesp.lcd-2432S024C
summary: Sunton ESP32-2432S024C: 2.4" 240x320 TFT, CST820 capacitive touch, SD and a local Vuesp web interface.
description:
## Vuesp LCD 2432S024C

ESP32 firmware for the Sunton/DIYmalls ESP32-2432S024C board: 2.4" 240x320 ILI9341 TFT, CST820 capacitive touch, microSD, RGB LED, speaker, LDR and battery input.

The first version focuses on a local status/diagnostics screen and the standard Vuesp web interface.
